profile.headline: Software engineer II at Rhapsody
profile.summary: Experienced in coding popular object oriented programming languages such as Java, C# and Python. Currently, focusing on improving my knowledge with Amazon Web Services. I am also a mentor for new hires who are aligned to AWS capability. I was in charge of curating an AWS training guide and host training sessions for new employees.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
•Built and deployed a cloud-native API gateway while ensuring for reliability and scalability.
•Designed a scalable Kubernetes deployment model using Helm and templated infrastructure.
•Delivered a full dev and prod environment, produced clear implementation docs, and enabled clients to operate with minimal support.
•Owned the middleware features of the API Gateway lifecycle and created custom gateway extensions for the middleware to enhance the API lifecycle.
•Added authentication logic, authorization layers, analytics hooks, metric collection, and alerting for healthcare workloads for the API Gateway
•Developed internal APIs and service components in .NET/C#. Ensured secure, reliable communication between platform services(Electronic Health Record[EHR] application integration).
•Built a structured metric pipeline using Redis, PostgreSQL, and custom data models. Supported dashboards, monitoring, and operational decision-making.
•Authored automation scripts, CI/CD workflows, and configuration standards. Improved team velocity and reduced onboarding friction across engineering and customer teams with easy to follow documentations.
•Experienced in leveraging AI-assisted(approved by Rhapsody) development and prompt engineering to accelerate research, automation, and software delivery workflows.
•Consistently recognized by leadership and peers for exceptional performance, delivering above expectations across multiple review cycles and high-visibility engineering initiatives.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Solution Architecture · Integration Engineering · API Development

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•Led a team of 10 in building a data management tool from concept to demo. Drove collaboration, task ownership, and delivery while maintaining project clarity and momentum.
•Developed and improved DynamoDB scripts to scan, modify, and migrate data, increasing data accessibility and operational efficiency.
•Created and updated REST APIs using Node.js, improving performance, reliability, and maintainability of core services.
•Designed and executed positive and negative test cases with Mocha and Chai to ensure API quality, correctness, and compliance.
•Performed detailed API analysis using Postman and AWS CloudWatch Logs, validating performance and
identifying improvement opportunities.
•Diagnosed and resolved performance bottlenecks across API endpoints, improving throughput and reducing latency.
•Utilized the Serverless Framework to build and modify launch templates, supporting scalable and cost-efficient serverless architectures.
•Authored a comprehensive AWS training guide and delivered hands-on onboarding sessions, accelerating new hire ramp-up and team readiness.
•Mentored hackathon participants in designing and presenting a client-focused demo, strengthening their technical skills and collaborative problem-solving.
positions.insights: Skills: Scrum · Software Development · Project Management · Mentoring · NodeJs

positions.title: Student Peer mentor
positions.description: As a mentor, I support and encourage new Cal Poly Pomona transfer students for success by creating a necessary plan for a path to success. I mentored 14 students and communicated with them on weekly basis to track their progress. I provided my mentees with resources and guidance to help them achieve their goals.

positions.title: Math and Psychics tutor
positions.locationName: 1235 N Harbor Blvd suite 150, Fullerton, CA 92832
positions.description: I provided tutoring for skill based mathematics in Algebra I, Geometry and Trigonometry. I evaluated students to measure skill progression and determine improvement areas. I also prepared weekly task for specific chapters and additional worksheets and quizzes for extra practice for the students.

positions.title: EOPS counseling Program Advisor
positions.description: Assist counselors with creating appointments. Making and receiving phone calls. Providing information to new students at cypress college requiring about EOPS program.

positions.title: Guest Services Associate
positions.description:
Working in Guest Service gave me the opportunity to gain more experience on interacting with people. I was able to help the guest in any problem and make sure they continue to enjoy their remainder time at the park. 

I have experience with money handling by selling admission ticket.

projects.title: Resource Data Management and visualization
projects.description:
•Initiated the side project to replace internal employee tracking process at Capgemini to enhance people managers workflow
•Led a team of 10 to create a data visualization app, focusing on clear and engaging data presentation on internal employees database
•Utilized Agile Scrum to analyze requirements and formulate backlog items, ensuring smooth project progression.
•Successful demo of the application to our executives lead to further development of the application even after I parted ways with Capgemini
